department: Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), GNCTD

name.en: Delhi Arogya Kosh (DAK) — Free High-End Diagnostics, Surgeries & Critical Care

bilingual_title.en: Delhi Arogya Kosh (DAK) — Free High-End Diagnostics, Surgeries & Critical Care

eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Bona fide Delhi resident for last 3 years; Gurugram/Faridabad/Noida/Ghaziabad excluded.
eligibility_criteria.age_range: All ages (minor's Birth Certificate + parent domicile accepted)
eligibility_criteria.income_cap: Annual family income up to ₹3,00,000 (or <₹1,00,000 for NFSA cardholders)
eligibility_criteria.category_rules: Low-income Delhi residents undergoing treatment at a Delhi govt hospital.
eligibility_criteria.academic_or_work_rules: Govt hospital referral / medical estimate required.
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Less than 3 years Delhi residency, income >₹3,00,000, or non-NCT NCR residents.

benefit.summary_hi: पात्र दिल्ली निवासियों को सरकारी अस्पताल उपचार हेतु ₹5 लाख तक वित्तीय सहायता तथा निःशुल्क महंगे टेस्ट, सर्जरी व डायलिसिस।
benefit.summary_en: Financial aid up to ₹5,00,000 for eligible Delhi govt hospital treatment + free high-end diagnostics, specified surgeries & dialysis per DAK rules.

benefit_summary.en: Financial aid up to ₹5,00,000 for eligible Delhi govt hospital treatment + free high-end diagnostics, specified surgeries & dialysis per DAK rules.
benefit_summary.hi: पात्र दिल्ली निवासियों को सरकारी अस्पताल उपचार हेतु ₹5 लाख तक वित्तीय सहायता तथा निःशुल्क महंगे टेस्ट, सर्जरी व डायलिसिस।

documents_required: SDM Income Certificate (<=₹3L) or NFSA Card

application_steps.offline: Submit via treating Govt Hospital Patient Welfare Cell / MS office.
application_steps.facilitation_center: Delhi Govt Hospital Patient Welfare Cell / CFC

anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_hi: सरकारी CFC या CSC केंद्र पर केवल निर्धारित सेवा शुल्क (₹0–₹50) व पक्की रसीद लागू
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_en: Nominal authorized CFC/CSC facilitation fee only (always take printed receipt)
anti_dalal.receipt_rule: Always collect your official Acknowledgement Slip & Reference Number after submission. Never pay without a printed receipt.
anti_dalal.middleman_warning: Never pay agents/middlemen promising guaranteed approval or faster clearance. Benefits are disbursed strictly via DBT / official portals.
